Local know-how

Spring cleanup in Guelph

What winter leaves behind. After a Guelph winter, most yards have the same list: leaves that came down after the last fall rake, sticks and small branches from wind and ice, gravel and sand pushed onto the lawn edge by plows and shovels, and matted, flattened patches where snow sat the longest. Left alone, that layer keeps the grass underneath cold, wet and shaded just as it’s trying to green up.

Snow mould. Grey or pinkish matted circles in the lawn as the snow melts are usually snow mould. The fix is mostly air and light: a gentle rake to lift the matted grass and clearing debris off the top lets the area dry out and recover.

Timing — and why not to rush. The most common spring mistake is working the lawn too early. Guelph’s heavier soils stay soft for a while after the thaw, and raking or walking on a saturated lawn compacts it and rips out grass that’s barely rooted. Our rule is simple: if your footprints stay in the lawn, it’s too early. That usually lands around mid-April, but we book by conditions, not the calendar.

Preparing for spring growth. Once the spring lawn cleanup is done and the turf is dry, the first cut — taken at the right height, never scalped — tidies winter-flattened grass and encourages the lawn to thicken up. Spring is also when we’ll flag anything that needs more than a cleanup, like thin or compacted areas that would benefit from aeration and overseeding.

Garden beds. Clearing out last year’s stems and debris, then re-cutting bed edges, gives perennials room to come up and makes weeding far easier for the rest of the year.

Township of Puslinch

Spring cleanup in Puslinch

Puslinch properties — in Aberfoyle, Morriston, Arkell and around Puslinch Lake — usually mean more ground to cover and more of what winter brings down: fallen branches from woodlot edges, long driveway and laneway edges with plow debris, and bigger beds and borders.

  • Conditions vary by property. Low-lying areas and lots near wetlands or the lake can stay wet longer than a city yard, so we check ground conditions before booking your spring yard cleanup.
  • Haul-away included. Puslinch is served by the County of Wellington’s leaf and yard-waste program rather than the City of Guelph’s, and curbside pickup doesn’t reach every rural address — so we take what we collect with us.
  • Quoted individually. Rural lots differ too much for a flat rate; your quote is based on your actual property.

Common questions

Spring cleanup FAQ

How much does spring cleanup cost in Guelph?

It depends on the property, so every spring cleanup gets its own firm quote. The main factors are lot size, how much was left over from the fall (leaves, sticks, matted areas), how many garden beds need clearing, and how much material has to be hauled away. Send your address through the quote form and we’ll reply with a price within 24 hours.

When should spring cleanup start?

When the lawn is firm enough to walk on without leaving footprints — in Guelph that’s usually around mid-April, but it shifts every year. Raking and walking on a soggy lawn compacts the soil and tears up grass that’s just waking up, so we schedule by conditions, not by the calendar.

What is included in spring cleanup?

Removal of winter debris, sticks and leftover leaves from the lawn and beds; a rake-out of matted areas; garden beds cleaned out and edges re-defined; the first cut of the season at the correct height; and haul-away of everything we collect. Your quote lists exactly what’s included for your yard.

Does Yardex service Puslinch?

Yes. We do spring cleanups in the Township of Puslinch — including Aberfoyle, Morriston and the Puslinch Lake area — as well as across Guelph. Larger rural lots are quoted individually.

Can I book a one-time spring cleanup?

Yes. Spring cleanup is a standalone service with no contract and no cancellation fee. Many clients book a one-time cleanup and then decide whether they want weekly lawn mowing for the season — totally up to you.

How do I request a quote?

Fill in the short quote form with your address and what you need, or call or text (519) 835-0774. We reply within 24 hours, usually the same day, with a firm price.
